task.title: Does Monday.com Have a Video Chat Function?

user_message.content: doers monday.com have a video chat function?

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
**No, Monday.com does not have a built-in video chat function.**

Monday.com is primarily a work operating system (Work OS) focused on project management, task tracking, and team collaboration through boards, timelines, and workflows. It does **not** include native video calling or video chat capabilities.

However, Monday.com integrates with popular video conferencing tools, allowing you to connect and launch calls directly from within the platform:

| Integration | What It Does |
|---|---|
| **Zoom** | Schedule and join Zoom meetings directly from Monday.com items |
| **Microsoft Teams** | Link Teams meetings to tasks and boards |
| **Google Meet** | Attach Meet links to items or automations |
| **Slack** | Communicate and initiate Slack Huddles (audio/video) from notifications |

These integrations can be set up via the **Monday.com Integration Center**, enabling you to streamline communication without leaving the platform — though the actual video call takes place in the third-party app.

If native video chat is a priority, tools like **Notion + Slack**, **ClickUp**, or **Asana** similarly rely on third-party integrations rather than built-in video.

user_message.content: if my team all had the same connectors applied in their settings - could i then collaborate tasks with them ?

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
**Yes, absolutely** — if everyone on your team has the same integrations/connectors configured, you can collaborate on tasks very effectively within Monday.com. Here is how it works in practice:

**What shared connectors enable:**

| Connector | Collaboration Benefit |
|---|---|
| **Zoom / Google Meet / Teams** | Anyone on the board can schedule or join meetings linked to a specific task or item |
| **Slack** | Automated notifications and updates are pushed to shared Slack channels when tasks change status, are assigned, or have due dates approaching |
| **Email (e.g., Outlook / Gmail)** | Team members can send and receive task-related emails directly from Monday.com items |
| **Google Drive / OneDrive** | Shared file attachments linked to tasks are accessible by all collaborators |

**Core Monday.com collaboration features that work regardless of connectors:**

Beyond integrations, Monday.com's native features already support strong team collaboration:

- **Task assignment** — assign one or multiple team members to any item
- **@ mentions** — tag teammates in updates and comments on tasks
- **Status updates & activity log** — everyone sees real-time changes to tasks
- **Workdocs** — collaborative documents embedded directly in boards
- **Automations** — trigger notifications or actions when tasks are updated

**Important consideration:** Connectors like Zoom or Slack typically need to be authorized per user (each person authenticates their own account). So while the *same connector* needs to be enabled for everyone, each team member usually links their own personal account to it — not just a single shared setting.

In short, Monday.com is **built for team collaboration**, and having consistent connectors across your team simply enhances that by bridging communication tools your team already uses.
